defs.def: one of a pair of outer coverings for your feet, usually made of leather or plastic 鞋

ex.s: I tried to put myself in my brother’s shoes.
ex.t: 我试着把自己放在我哥哥的鞋子里。

ex.s: So for them to move to Elkhead, Colo. to instruct the children whose shoes were held together with string was a surprise.
ex.t: 因此，让他们搬到科罗拉多州的埃尔克黑德，指导鞋子用绳子捆在一起的孩子们是一个惊喜。

ex.s: We put ourselves in the passengers’ shoes and help them as much as we can.
ex.t: 我们站在乘客的立场，尽我们所能帮助他们。

ex.s: Dirty shorts and old shoes gave him the ____26____ of a real beggar and his convincing dialect soon won him the ____27____ of the beggars.
ex.t: 脏兮兮的短裤和旧鞋给了他真正的乞丐的____ 26 ____ ，他令人信服的方言很快为他赢得了乞丐的____ 27 ____。

ex.s: If you want time to have breakfast with your family, save some time the night before by setting out clothes, shoes, and bags.
ex.t: 如果你想和家人一起吃早饭,请在前一天晚上把衣服、鞋子和袋子放好。

ex.s: At the information desk at the entrance, I asked a lady where the shoe section was.
ex.t: 在入口处的咨询台，我问一位女士鞋子的位置。

ex.s: So I went up to the first floor, but couldn't find any shoes.
ex.t: 所以我去了一楼，但找不到鞋子。

ex.s: When I was looking for the exit, I saw that shoes were actually sold downstairs on the ground floor, not the first floor.
ex.t: 当我寻找出口时，我看到鞋子实际上是在一楼出售的，而不是在一楼。

ex.s: But just when I thought I could deal with all Chinese food, I came across stinky tofu, a horrible grey thing that looked and smelt like a burnt sports shoe.
ex.t: 但是就在我以为我可以处理所有中国食物的时候，我遇到了臭豆腐，一种看起来和闻起来都像烧焦的运动鞋的可怕的灰色东西。

ex.s: Remember to wear comfortable walking shoes.
